text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet has ordered work to begin immediately on 20 flood-control projects in southern Vietnam's Mekong Delta at a cost of $27.7 million.
-- The Swedish Government will provide $9 million to support a land administration reform programme in Vietnam.
-- ASEAN diplomats have expressed support for Vietnam in a dispute relating to Chinese oil exploration in Vietnam's territorial waters.
-- The British Consulate General and the British Council Office in Ho Chi Minh City were officially opened by Britain's ambassador to Vietnam Peter Williams, on March 21.
-- Vice Prime Minister Phan Van Khai paid a two-day visit to Jordan on March 22 and 23 and signed a trade agreement with the Jordanian government.
-- Communist Party General Secretary Do Muoi received a delegation from the Central Committee of the Laos Front for National Reconstruction yesterday in Hanoi.
-- The Ministry of Labour, War Invalids and Social Affairs will begin issuing working permits to foreigners in Vietnam from April 2.
